item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00083","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C06","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 is a direct drafting template for the child. Both orders use the same compact sequence: the relevant entity caused a seal to be made and recommended presidential approval; the accompanying design is incorporated into the order and described; a second recital finds the seal suitable and appropriate as the entity's official seal; and the text closes with “NOW, THEREFORE.” The child adapts this machinery and much of its language to a newly created corporation. C06 also concerns an official seal and incorporates accompanying illustrations and specifications, but its form and operative structure are less similar. C25 concerns the same corporation but supplies no comparable seal-approval language or machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation ... has ... caused to be made and has adopted a corporate seal; and ... the Administrator ... has recommended that I approve such seal","parent_excerpt":"the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics has caused to be made and has recommended that I approve a seal of office","explanation":"Distinctive shared predicate and presidential-approval formulation, adapted to the corporation's statutory authority and administrator."},{"child_excerpt":"the design of which accompanies and is hereby made a part of this order, and which is described in heraldic terms as follows","parent_excerpt":"the design of which accompanies and is hereby made a part of this order, and which is of the following description","explanation":"Nearly identical incorporation-and-description clause."},{"child_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that such seal is of suitable design and appropriate for use as the corporate seal of the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation","parent_excerpt":"AND WHEREAS it appears that such seal is of suitable design and appropriate for establishment as the official seal of the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics","explanation":"The same suitability finding is reused with only the institutional target and characterization of the seal changed."},{"child_excerpt":"NOW, THEREFORE","parent_excerpt":"NOW, TBEREPORE","explanation":"Both texts culminate in the same operative transition after the parallel seal-related recitals; the parent's spelling reflects an apparent transcription error."}]}
